description: Query real-time room types and pricing for a single hotel (room types, price and tax, availability, cancellation policy, etc.). Used for a second price check after the user has selected a specific hotel.

dateParam.description: Check-in / check-out date object. Fields: checkInDate (string, YYYY-MM-DD, pass a valid future date when possible); checkOutDate (string, YYYY-MM-DD, must be later than checkInDate).

hotelId.description: Hotel unique ID. Use this or `name`; if both are provided, `hotelId` takes priority (obtain it from the searchHotels tool).

localeParam.description: Locale/currency preference. Fields: countryCode (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, default US); currency (ISO 4217, default USD).

name.description: Hotel name (fuzzy match). Only used when `hotelId` is absent.

occupancyParam.description: Occupancy details. Fields: adultCount (integer, >=1, default 2); childCount (integer, >=0, default 0); childAgeDetails (array of child ages, e.g. [3,5]); roomCount (integer, >=1, default 1).

name: getHotelDetail
